meta.name: X Company
meta.description:
An emotionally-driven character drama, set in the thrilling and dangerous world of WWII espionage and covert operations. It follows the stories of five highly skilled young recruits - Canadian, American and British - torn from their ordinary lives to train as agents in an ultra-secret facility on the shores of Lake Ontario. These agents parachute behind enemy lines, where they're fair game for torture and execution. From elegant hotels to hellholes in the field, it's one risky operation after another, masterminded by the brains of Camp X.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: As a new team of Allied agents face a terrifying first mission, Camp X's spymaster Duncan Sinclair must convince a fragile young man with a perfect memory to join the fight.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: It’s a trial-by-fire first mission for Alfred as the team parachutes into France. Their mission: to penetrate a German headquarters and steal codes that could save thousands of British lives.

videos.title: Kiss of Death
videos.overview: The team infiltrates a brothel and a Gestapo headquarters as they battle to stop atomic research from falling into the hands of the Nazis.

videos.title: Sixes & Sevens
videos.overview: The team engineers a high-risk extraction of a British airman with the help of an infamous jazz chanteuse. Meanwhile, Harry struggles to help a critically injured Frenchwoman deliver her baby.

videos.title: Walk with the Devil
videos.overview: Aurora and the team wrestle with whether to trust a Vichy Mayor, who offers rich intelligence in exchange for their help in discovering what has become of the town’s young women.

videos.title: In Enemy Hands
videos.overview: A sabotage mission leaves Harry critically injured and the team trapped in a safe house, desperate to escape a town swarming with Nazis. In the midst of the crisis, Neil learns that killing the enemy isn’t so easy when you get to know them first...

videos.title: Quislings
videos.overview: The team reaches Paris, tasked with assassinating French civilians who collaborate with the Nazis. As Aurora and Neil face ghosts from their past, Tom discovers a man carrying Germany’s darkest secret.

videos.title: Into the Fire
videos.overview: As Paris is torn by a massive roundup of Jews, the team must help an early Holocaust witness bring his story to Allied leaders. Meanwhile, German agents close in on Aurora and Alfred…

videos.title: Creon Via London
videos.overview: The team reels from the disaster of losing Alfred to the Nazis. Making matters worse, Aurora, Neil, Tom and Harry have been cut off from all communications with Camp X.

videos.title: Night Will End
videos.overview: Franz Faber tries to get Alfred to break using inhuman techniques.  Sinclair leads the team on a rescue mission in France.

videos.title: Schein Und Sein
videos.overview: With the Gestapo hot on their heels and no way out of France, the team must get creative to get Alfred and René back to Camp

videos.title: Last Man, Last Round
videos.overview: Alfred stuns his teammates when he puts his life on the line to help free the British POWs who can help rebuild their resistance networks.

videos.title: Nil Nocere
videos.overview: The team goes in search of a doctor, rumoured to be helping Jews escape France, while Aurora gets closer to Franz Faber's wife.

videos.title: Black Flag
videos.overview: Tension within the team explodes when Harry defies Auroras orders and sets a plan in motion to assassinate a high-ranking German general.

videos.title: La Vérité Vous Rendra Libre
videos.overview: Aurora struggles to maintain her leadership as divisions within the team grow deeper. A brutal midnight attack by German commandos threatens to destroy their fledgling guerrilla army.

videos.title: Fatherland
videos.overview: The team is forced to mobilize to Dieppe without Aurora, unaware she's caught in a dramatic showdown with Franz Faber on a train. Sinclair's friendship with Klaus nearly costs him his life.

videos.title: Butcher and Bolt
videos.overview: Aurora fights to regain her team's faith as Alfred finally reveals their Dieppe objectives: a raid on a German radar station in the midst of the Allied attack, and a daring attempt to steal the secrets of the Enigma machine.

videos.title: August 19th
videos.overview: The team pays a devastating price at Dieppe as Alfred and Aurora put everything on the line to try and "turn" Franz Faber.

videos.title: Creon vs. Ixion
videos.overview: After the sobering losses at Dieppe, Sinclair joins the team in Paris galvanized by the possibility of cultivating Franz Faber as a double agent.

videos.title: Masquerade
videos.overview: The team discovers a secret Nazi operation.

videos.title: One for the Moon
videos.overview: The team tries to rally France before the Nazis take over. Faber's transfer could cost the team.

videos.title: Promises
videos.overview: The team is ordered to follow Faber to Poland, but the road to Operation Marigold proves deadly.

videos.title: Frontiers
videos.overview: The team sets out to free Faber. Aurora takes on a new undercover job.

videos.title: Supply and Demand
videos.overview: Aurora struggles to keep her cover as Helene Bauer as the Nazis hunt for spies among the Polish resistance. Two new Camp X recruits join the team on a dangerous mission that brings them closer to the heart of Operation Marigold.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: With an impending attack on Nadzieja, Aurora goes to extremes to prove her loyalty to Schmidt and the Nazi cause.

videos.title: Naqam
videos.overview: When Heidi finds out that Aurora is a spy, the team's mission starts to unravel.

videos.title: Friendly Fire
videos.overview: With plans to assassinate the man who could win for the Nazis, Sinclair and Krystina join the team in Berlin.

videos.title: Remembrance
videos.overview: The final mission could impact the course of the war. Aurora needs Faber's help.

meta.slogan: The allies needed a secret weapon. They got five.
